name: LOLA data ingest, coordinate conversion, and topography geometry verification
purpose: Verify label-driven D01 decoding, longitude/latitude conversion, interpolation, and triangulated geometry.
configuration: D01 LDEM_4 IMG/LBL; no smoothing or undocumented resampling.
independent_reference: Four native IMG samples decoded independently before the test was run, plus icosphere topology identities and outward-orientation invariants.
units: degrees and metres relative to the label-defined reference sphere
frame_time_convention: Label-defined lunar body-fixed coordinates; longitude convention explicit.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic decoder and control-point selection fixed before comparison.
procedure: Parse the moon section, verify native label metadata and byte count, decode four fixed native pixel centres, generate a 500 km icosphere, apply DEM radii, check topology/edge uniformity/orientation, and parse the CEA and Tecplot outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Exact label dimensions, reference radius, and four native pixel-centre elevations; 642 vertices and 1280 faces; maximum great-circle edge <=500000 m; minimum/maximum chord ratio >=0.75; every face outward; CEA record counts exact; Tecplot FETRIANGLE header present.
expected_pass_result: A reproducible D01 geometry product is numerically correct.
status_semantics: The production-kernel subcheck may pass, but the U08 campaign remains SKIPPED / NOT VALIDATED until D01 has README, provenance.json, and qa_report.json and its readiness is qualified.
skip_reason: The local D01 directory contains raw IMG/LBL files but no package README, provenance.json, or qa_report.json.
missing_capability: Qualified D01 package and linked I14 production-wiring verification.
